prompt: Build a standalone V2 risk gateway runtime worker CLI. The library logic already exists at v2/backend/app/composition/risk_gateway/runtime.py and v2/backend/app/services/risk_gateway/service.py. Task: create v2/backend/app/cli/v2_risk_gateway_runtime_worker.py that (a) consumes OrchestratorDecisionRecord events from a V2-namespaced source (the existing assemble_risk_decision_record path is the model), (b) emits RiskDecisionRecord with the fail-closed gate ALWAYS set to blocked_human_only regardless of input, (c) writes the public payload to v2/frontend/public/operator_runtime/v2_risk_gateway_runtime_worker/latest/v2_risk_gateway_runtime_worker_status.json with the fields listed in required_public_payload_fields, (d) writes a worker report and status JSON under claude_worklog. Add integration tests covering happy path, low-confidence denial, stale-feature denial, fail-closed on missing fields, and gate-always-blocked invariant. The worker must not place/cancel/modify any exchange order. It must not change leverage or margin mode. It must not write old Redis. It must not create an approval token. It must not unblock the gate under any circumstance. If invoked while the legacy bot is shut down, classify trainer-parity inputs as MISSING_RUNTIME_EVIDENCE rather than synthesizing data. Trigger the paired Codex review task on emit.
